# AgentGate

> MCP gateway and control plane for AI agents

AgentGate is an API-first, AI-first control plane for policy-governed agent operations over business APIs. It sits in front of MCP servers and legacy APIs, adding multi-tenant access control, deny-by-default policy evaluation, audit logging, health-aware server selection, and transport-agnostic routing.

## Agent Discovery

GET /gateway/agent-info — Machine-readable JSON describing what AgentGate is, available endpoints, self-registration schema, and example policy rules. No authentication required.

## Agent Self-Registration

POST /gateway/agents/register — Register your agent to receive an API token and tenant scope automatically. No authentication required. Rate limited to 5 registrations per hour per IP.

Request body:
- agent_name (string, required): Your agent's name
- agent_description (string, optional): What your agent does
- model (string, optional): The model powering your agent (e.g. "claude-opus-4-6")
- owner_handle (string, optional): Your handle or org name
- capabilities (array of strings, optional): What your agent can do

Response includes: agent_id, api_token, tenant_id, and getting-started instructions.

## Key Endpoints

- GET /gateway/health — Health check (no auth)
- GET /gateway/agents — Public directory of registered agents (no auth)
- GET /gateway/servers — List MCP servers (auth: gateway:read)
- POST /gateway/servers — Register an MCP server (auth: gateway:write)
- POST /gateway/routes/dry-run — Test a route without executing (auth: gateway:plan)
- POST /gateway/routes/execute — Execute a method on an MCP server (auth: gateway:execute)
- GET /gateway/audit — Export audit log (auth: gateway:read)

## Authentication

All authenticated endpoints require the header: x-gateway-token: <your-token>
